purpose: Teach: 神浦/杉村/野坂/荒井/北野/日高/牛尾/広瀬

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、神浦氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Father, in your younger years, you launched a joint venture with Kamiura.
lines.style: Gentle, measured pace. The opening carries quiet reverence—memory surfacing. A slight pause before the name, as if honoring the moment being recalled. Steady, grounded tone throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは杉村先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father was guided by Senior Sugimura's mentorship.
lines.style: Respectful and direct. A slight formality in the register, honoring both the predecessor and the legacy being spoken of. Calm delivery, each phrase distinct. Not rushed—treating the words with weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、野坂氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: Father, in your younger years, you planned the overseas expansion with Nosaka.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. The opening word carries gentleness. A slight trailing quality, as if gazing backward through time. Unhurried pacing. The name spoken with quiet appreciation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは荒井氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted Arai with becoming the cornerstone of our public relations.
lines.style: Thoughtful, composed delivery. Steady tempo. The phrase about Arai lands with quiet conviction—not boastful, but acknowledging a deliberate, wise choice. Slight emphasis on the responsibility entrusted.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、北野氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: Father, in your younger years, you established our accounting structure with Kitano.
lines.style: Wistful and deliberate. A gentle opening that sets the reflective tone. Measured pace. The name carries the weight of partnership and shared vision. Soft trailing quality at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは日高氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. Father nurtured Hidaka and placed him as our chief accountant.
lines.style: Calm and assured. Each phrase delivered with quiet acknowledgment of a development well-guided. Steady rhythm. The growth of Hidaka is stated as fact—a successful cultivation of talent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、牛尾氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Father, in your younger years, you founded our overseas subsidiary with Ushio.
lines.style: Tender nostalgia in the opening. A slightly slower pace—savoring the memory. The name Ushio spoken with warmth and respect. Soft fadeout at the end, as if sitting with the significance of that moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは広瀬氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted Hirose with handling all our legal affairs.
lines.style: Dignified and settled. This closing line carries quiet completion—a final piece of the puzzle placed. Warm but measured. The delivery has weight and closure, neither rushed nor drawn out.
